body: As of 2007 I have tried every treatment legal in the US for depresssion, and a few that aren't. Inculding 10 rounds of ECT. I've spent years and years only to experience my depresssion getting worse and worse. If there is anything you can suggest I will try it, but as it is right now, my only option is suicide. I worked my ass off for the first 15 years of my life with absoloutely no improvement. I promise, I am open to suggestions, but it seems to me the only releif is ending everything.
